description: A closed tank 0.6 x 0.6 m (dx 1 cm) with a plate through the free surface (S 10, x 0.273-0.327 m, z 0.153-0.45 m, open below, the air free above); the surface starts tilted (F 57) and the water sloshes under the plate. Two refined levels on the interface band alone (G 1 2, G 24 1.0, no G 25), so the patches of both levels are rebuilt as the surface moves and their edges meet the plate. Around step 212 all patches of a regrid are new: before the patch a new patch had no acceleration term (maxF, maxG, maxH) in its first time step criterion, the step doubled and the air at the plate reached 3.6 m/s (0.17 m/s before and after). Around step 240 the upper edge of a new level-2 patch comes to lie at the plate in the air: before the second patch its edge faces in the forcing band of the plate kept a share of the pressure gradient of the coarse level under the patch, 1.75 m/s in one step (0.24 m/s before).
covers: cfd_amr::timestep: the acceleration terms of a patch made at a regrid (ts_acc)
cfd_amr::pr_predict: an edge face deeper in a solid than its coarse face, the share (1-Hf)/(1-Hcs) of the coarse stage velocity
